units.zh: 列傳第七十二 外國上 ○西夏
units.en: Biography 72: Foreign Countries (Part 1) — Western Xia
units.literal: Biographies 72, Foreign Countries, Upper Section. Western Xia.

units.zh: 夏國王李乾順。
units.en: The King of Xia was Li Qianshun.
units.literal: The king of the Xia state was Li Qianshun.

units.zh: 其先曰托跋思恭，唐僖宗時，為夏、綏、銀、宥節度使，與李茂貞、李克用等破黃巢，複京師，賜姓李氏。
units.en: His forebear Tuoba Sigong served under Emperor Xizong of Tang as military commissioner of Xia, Sui, Yin, and You. Together with Li Maozhen, Li Keyong, and others he routed Huang Chao, restored the capital, and received the imperial surname Li.
units.literal: His ancestor was called Tuoba Sigong; in the time of Emperor Xizong of Tang he was military commissioner of Xia, Sui, Yin, and You, and with Li Maozhen, Li Keyong, and others defeated Huang Chao, recovered the capital, and was granted the surname Li.

units.zh: 唐末，天下大亂，籓鎮連兵，惟夏州未嘗為唐患。
units.en: In the closing years of Tang the empire fell into chaos as military governors warred among themselves, yet Xia Prefecture never troubled the dynasty.
units.literal: At the end of Tang the realm was in great disorder and frontier governors fought one another in succession, but Xia Prefecture never once became a trouble to Tang.

units.zh: 曆五代至宋，傳數世至元昊，始稱帝。
units.en: The line passed through the Five Dynasties and into Song for several generations until Yuanhao, who was the first to proclaim himself emperor.
units.literal: Through the Five Dynasties into Song the line was transmitted for several generations until Yuanhao, when he first declared himself emperor.

units.zh: 遼人以公主下嫁李氏，世修朝貢不絕，事具《遼史》。
units.en: The Liao Khitan bestowed a princess on the Li house, and for generations the Xia court kept up tribute and embassies without interruption, as recorded in the History of Liao.
units.literal: The Khitan of Liao married a princess to the Li house; generation after generation they maintained court tribute without break—the details are in the History of Liao.

units.zh: 天輔六年，金破遼兵，遼主走陰山，夏將李良輔將兵三萬來救遼，次天德境野穀。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianfu (1122), Jin routed the Liao armies and the Liao emperor fled toward the Yin Mountains. Xia general Li Liangfu marched thirty thousand troops to Liao's aid and camped at Yegu on the Tiande frontier.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu, Jin defeated Liao troops; the Liao sovereign fled to the Yin Mountains. The Xia general Li Liangfu led thirty thousand men to rescue Liao, halting at Yegu in the Tiande borderlands.

units.zh: 斡魯、婁室敗之于宜水，追至野谷，澗水暴至，漂沒者不可勝計。
units.en: Wulu and Loushi defeated them at Yishui and pursued them to Yegu, where flash floods in the ravine drowned countless soldiers.
units.literal: Wulu and Loushi defeated them at Yishui and pursued them to Yegu; the ravine waters rose suddenly and those swept away and drowned were beyond counting.

units.zh: 宗望至陰山，以便宜與夏國議和，其書曰：「奉詔有之：夏王，遼之自出，不渝終始，危難相救。
units.en: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, acting on his own authority, opened peace talks with Xia. His letter read: "By imperial command: Xia King—you were born of Liao's own line and have stood firm from beginning to end, rescuing each other in peril.
units.literal: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, exercising discretionary authority, negotiated peace with the Xia state. His letter said: "By imperial order: Xia King—you sprang from Liao itself and have not wavered from first to last, aiding one another in hardship.

units.zh: 今茲已舉遼國，若能如事遼之日以效職貢，當聽其來，毋致疑貳。
units.en: Now that Liao has been brought down, if you resume tribute and service as you did for Liao, you may present yourself freely—let there be no hint of divided allegiance.
units.literal: Now that Liao has been overthrown, if you can render duty and tribute as in your days under Liao, you will be allowed to come; do not give cause for doubt and divided loyalty.

units.zh: 若遼主至彼，可令執送。」
units.en: Should the Liao emperor reach your realm, seize him and send him to us."
units.literal: If the Liao sovereign comes to your territory, you may have him seized and sent."

units.zh: 天會二年，始奉誓表，以事遼之禮稱籓，請受割賜之地。
units.en: In the second year of Tianhui (1124), they first submitted a sworn memorial, accepted vassal status on the Liao model, and asked to receive the territories Jin was granting them.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianhui they first submitted a sworn memorial, took vassal status in the manner of their service to Liao, and requested the lands granted by partition.

units.zh: 宗翰承制，割下寨以北、陰山以南、乙室耶刮部吐祿濼之西，以賜之。
units.en: Zonghan, acting on imperial command, granted them the lands north of Xia Fortress, south of the Yin Mountains, and west of the Tulu Bo marshes of the Yishi Yegua tribe.
units.literal: Zonghan, acting by imperial order, ceded to them the area north of Xia Fortress, south of the Yin Mountains, and west of Tulu Bo of the Yishi Yegua tribe.

units.zh: 天會二年三月，乾順遣把裏公亮等來上誓表，曰：「臣乾順言：今月十五日，西南、西北兩路都統遣左諫議大夫王介儒等齎牒奉宣，若夏國追悔前非，捕送遼主，立盟上表，仍依遼國舊制及賜誓詔，將來或有不虞，交相救援者。
units.en: In the third month of Tianhui 2, Qianshun dispatched Bali Gongliang and others with the sworn memorial: "Your subject Qianshun reports: On the fifteenth of this month Wang Jieru, Left Remonstrating Grandee, and others bearing documents from the Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders announced that if Xia repents its past offenses, captures and delivers the Liao emperor, seals alliance in writing, and keeps to the old Liao protocols and the sworn edict Jin has granted, then in any future emergency we shall aid each other.
units.literal: In the third month of the second year of Tianhui, Qianshun sent Bali Gongliang and others to present the sworn memorial, saying: "Your subject Qianshun submits: On the fifteenth of this month the commanders of the Southwest and Northwest circuits, Left Remonstrating Grandee Wang Jieru and others, delivered an edict proclaiming that if the Xia state repents its former errors, captures and sends the Liao sovereign, establishes alliance and submits a memorial, and still follows the old Liao system and the bestowed sworn edict, then should anything unforeseen arise in future, we shall rescue one another.

units.zh: 臣與遼國世通姻契，名系籓臣，輒為援以啟端，曾犯威而結釁。
units.en: My house and Liao have been joined by marriage for generations; I was registered as Liao's vassal, yet I took arms as their ally, offending your Majesty and inviting war.
units.literal: Your subject and the Liao state have been linked by marriage for generations; by title your subject was a vassal, yet acting as their ally opened hostilities and offended Majesty to forge enmity.

units.zh: 既速違天之咎，果罹敗績之憂。
units.en: I soon drew Heaven's punishment and suffered crushing defeat.
units.literal: Having swiftly incurred Heaven's wrath, I indeed suffered the anguish of defeat.

units.zh: 蒙降德音以寬前罪，仍賜土地用廣籓籬，載惟含垢之恩，常切戴天之望。
units.en: Your gracious edict pardoned my earlier crimes and granted lands to widen my frontier—an indulgence I hold in awe, with gratitude as deep as for life itself.
units.literal: I was favored with a gracious edict to pardon former offenses and was moreover granted lands to broaden the vassal barrier; I bear deeply in mind this grace of swallowing shame and am ever keenly mindful of gratitude bound to Heaven.

units.zh: 自今已後，凡于歲時朝賀、貢進表章、使人往復等事，一切永依臣事遼國舊例。
units.en: Henceforth seasonal audiences, tribute memorials, and all exchange of envoys shall forever follow the customs of my service to Liao.
units.literal: From this day forward, in all matters of seasonal court congratulations, tribute and memorials, and envoys coming and going, everything shall forever follow the old precedent of your subject's service to Liao.

units.zh: 其契丹昏主今不在臣境，至如奔竄到此，不復存泊，即當執獻。
units.en: The deluded Khitan emperor is not within my realm; should he flee here, I will not shelter him but will seize and deliver him at once.
units.literal: The benighted Liao Khitan ruler is not now within your subject's borders; should he flee and arrive here, he shall not be harbored but at once be seized and presented.

units.zh: 若大朝知其所在，以兵追捕，無敢為地及依前援助。
units.en: If the Great Court learns his whereabouts and sends troops in pursuit, I will neither give him refuge nor aid him as I did before.
units.literal: If the Great Court knows where he is and pursues him with troops, I dare not provide territory for refuge or aid him as before.

units.zh: 其或徵兵，即當依應。
units.en: Should you call upon my forces, I will answer the summons.
units.literal: Should troops be levied, I shall respond accordingly.

units.zh: 至如殊方異域朝覲天闕，合經當國道路，亦不阻節。
units.en: Foreign realms paying court at the capital, if their route crosses my land, shall pass without hindrance.
units.literal: As for distant regions paying court at the heavenly gate, if they must pass through your subject's territory, passage shall not be impeded.

units.zh: 以上所敘數事，臣誓固此誠，傳嗣不變，苟或有渝，天地鑒察，神明殛之，禍及子孫，不克享國。」
units.en: On all the points above I swear this oath for myself and my heirs; should I break it, may Heaven and Earth bear witness, the spirits destroy me, calamity fall on my descendants, and my line lose the throne."
units.literal: In regard to the several matters set forth above, your subject swears this sincerity firm; it shall be transmitted to heirs without change—if there be any breach, may Heaven and Earth witness, may the spirits strike me down, may disaster reach my descendants, and may I not long enjoy the state."

units.zh: 所謂西北，西南兩路都統者宗翰也。
units.en: The "Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders" referred to here were Zonghan.
units.literal: The so-called commanders of the Northwest and Southwest circuits were Zonghan.

units.zh: 蓋宗望以太祖命與之通書，而宗翰以便宜割地議和雲。
units.en: Zongwang had exchanged letters with Xia under the founding emperor's orders; Zonghan had ceded territory at his own discretion to conclude the peace.
units.literal: For Zongwang, by the founding emperor's order, had exchanged letters with them, while Zonghan by discretionary authority ceded land to negotiate peace.

units.zh: 太宗使王阿海、楊天吉往賜誓詔曰：「維天會二年歲次甲辰，閏三月戊寅朔，皇帝賜誓詔于夏國王乾順：先皇帝誕膺駿命，肇啟鴻圖，而卿國據夏台，境連遼右，以效力於昏主，致結釁于王師。
units.en: Emperor Taizong sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to deliver the sworn edict: "In Tianhui 2, year jiachen, on the first day of the intercalary third month, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict upon Xia King Qianshun: The late emperor received Heaven's mandate and founded our great enterprise, yet your state holds Xia Terrace on Liao's western border, serving a deluded sovereign and thereby drawing Our armies into war.
units.literal: Emperor Taizong sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to bestow the sworn edict, saying: "In the second year of Tianhui, cyclical year jiachen, the first day of the intercalary third month wuyin, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict on Xia King Qianshun: The former emperor received the glorious mandate and opened the great enterprise, yet your state occupies Xia Terrace, its border joining Liao's western flank, serving the benighted sovereign and thereby provoking enmity with Our armies.

units.zh: 先皇帝以謂忠於所事，務施恩而釋過，迨眇躬之纂紹，仰遺訓以遵行，卿乃深念前非，樂從內附，飭使軺而奉貢，效臣節以稱籓。
units.en: The late emperor judged that loyalty to one's sovereign deserved mercy; now that I have succeeded the throne I follow his testament. You have deeply repented your past errors, willingly submitted, sent envoys with tribute, and accepted vassal status with full ministerial devotion.
units.literal: The former emperor held that loyalty to one's lord deserves grace and the release of faults; now that this insignificant person has succeeded to the throne, I look up to his testamentary instructions to follow them. You have deeply reflected on past errors, gladly submitted to inner allegiance, ordered envoys in light carriages to present tribute, and shown ministerial devotion in declaring vassalage.

units.zh: 載錫寵光，用彰複好，所有割賜地土、使聘禮節、相為援助等事，一切恭依先朝制詔。
units.en: We bestow favor to renew our friendship; regarding the granted territories, diplomatic protocol, and mutual aid, all shall follow the regulations of the previous reign.
units.literal: Favor and glory are hereby bestowed to manifest renewed friendship; in all matters of partitioned and granted lands, envoy protocol, and mutual aid, everything shall respectfully follow the former court's established edicts.

units.zh: 其依應徵兵，所請宜允。
units.en: Your request to answer when troops are called upon is granted.
units.literal: As for responding when troops are levied, your request is approved.

units.zh: 三辰在上，朕豈食言，苟或變渝，亦如卿誓。
units.en: With Heaven as witness, I shall not break my word; should I fail, may I suffer as you swore for yourself.
units.literal: With sun, moon, and stars above as witness, how could I break my word? If there be any change or breach, it shall be as in your oath.

units.zh: 遠垂戒諭，毋替厥誠。」
units.en: From afar I send this charge: do not let your loyalty falter."
units.literal: From afar I send this admonition and instruction—do not let your sincerity lapse."

units.zh: 於是，宋人與夏人俱受山西地，宋人侵取之，乾順遣使表謝賜誓詔、並論宋所侵地。
units.en: Song and Xia had both received Shanxi territories, but Song seized portions of Xia's share. Qianshun sent envoys to thank Jin for the sworn edict and to protest Song's encroachments.
units.literal: Thereupon both Song and Xia received Shanxi lands; the Song encroached and seized them. Qianshun sent envoys with a memorial thanking them for the bestowed sworn edict and also addressing the lands the Song had encroached upon.

units.zh: 詔曰：「省所上表，具悉，已命西南、西北兩路都統府從宜定奪。」
units.en: An edict replied: "We have received your memorial and understand it; the Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders are authorized to settle the matter as they see fit."
units.literal: An edict said: "We have reviewed your submitted memorial and understand it fully; the Southwest and Northwest circuit command headquarters have been ordered to decide as circumstances require."

units.zh: 是時，宗翰朝京師未還，錄夏國奏付權都統斡魯，宋人侵略新受疆土、及使人王阿海爭儀物事，與夏通問以便宜決之。
units.en: Zonghan was still at court and had not returned; the Xia memorial was forwarded to Acting Commander Wulu with orders to settle, as circumstances required, both Song's encroachment on newly granted lands and the dispute over ceremonial gifts with envoy Wang Ahai through consultation with Xia.
units.literal: At this time Zonghan had not yet returned from audience at the capital; the Xia memorial was copied and sent to Acting Commander Wulu, with orders that matters of Song encroachment on newly granted territory and the dispute over protocol gifts with envoy Wang Ahai be settled by exchange with Xia as circumstances required.

units.zh: 初，以山西九州與宋人，而天德遠在一隅，緩急不可及，割以與夏。
units.en: Initially the nine Shanxi prefectures were granted to Song, but Tiande lay too remote for timely reinforcement, so that region was ceded to Xia instead.
units.literal: At first the nine prefectures of Shanxi were given to the Song, but Tiande lay far in a corner where urgent needs could not be met in time, so it was ceded to Xia.

units.zh: 後破宋都獲二帝，乃畫陝西分界，自麟府路洛陽溝東距黃河西岸、西曆暖泉堡，鄜延路米脂穀至累勝寨，環慶路威邊寨過九星原至委布穀口，涇原路威川寨略古蕭關至北谷川，秦鳳路通懷堡至古會州，自此直距黃河，依見今流行分熙河路盡西邊以限封域。
units.en: After Jin captured the Song capital and took the two emperors captive, a Shaanxi boundary was drawn: from Luoyang Gully on the Qinfu Circuit east to the Yellow River's west bank and west through Nuanquan Fort; on the Fuyan Circuit from Mizhi Valley to Leisheng Stockade; on the Huanqing Circuit from Weibian Stockade across Jiuxing Plain to Weibu Valley; on the Jingyuan Circuit from Weichuan Stockade past ancient Xia Pass to Beigu Valley; on the Qinfeng Circuit from Tonghuai Fort to ancient Huizhou—thence due south to the Yellow River, and along current practice the entire western Xihe Circuit was partitioned to fix the frontier.
units.literal: Later, after capturing the Song capital and taking the two emperors, the Shaanxi boundary was drawn: from Luoyang Gully east of the Yellow River's west bank on the Qinfu Circuit, west through Nuanquan Fort; on the Fuyan Circuit from Mizhi Valley to Leisheng Stockade; on the Huanqing Circuit from Weibian Stockade past Jiuxing Plain to Weibu Valley mouth; on the Jingyuan Circuit from Weichuan Stockade past ancient Xia Pass to Beigu Valley; on the Qinfeng Circuit from Tonghuai Fort to ancient Huizhou—thence straight to the Yellow River, and along present practice the entire western border of the Xihe Circuit was divided to delimit the frontier.

units.zh: 複分陝西北鄙以易天德、雲內，以河為界。
units.en: The northwestern Shaanxi marches were then reallocated, trading Tiande and Yunnei with the river as the boundary.
units.literal: The northwestern corner of Shaanxi was again partitioned, exchanging Tiande and Yunnei, with the river as boundary.

units.zh: 及婁室定陝西，婆盧火率兵先取威戎城。
units.en: When Loushi secured Shaanxi, Poluhuo led the vanguard to capture Weirong.
units.literal: When Loushi pacified Shaanxi, Poluhuo led troops first to take Weirong City.

units.zh: 軍至威戎東與敵遇，擊走之，生致二人，問之，乃知為夏將李遇取威戎也，乃還其人而與李遇通問。
units.en: East of Weirong they met the enemy, drove them off, and took two prisoners alive. Questioning revealed that Xia general Li Yu had seized Weirong, so they released the captives and opened correspondence with Li Yu.
units.literal: The army reached east of Weirong and met the enemy, routed them, and took two men alive; on questioning them they learned that Xia general Li Yu had taken Weirong, so they returned the captives and sent messages to Li Yu.

units.zh: 李遇軍威戎西，蒲察軍威戎東，而使使議事于婁室。
units.en: Li Yu held Weirong from the west and Pucha from the east, and envoys were dispatched to consult Loushi.
units.literal: Li Yu's army was west of Weirong and Pucha's army east of Weirong, and envoys were sent to discuss the matter with Loushi.

units.zh: 婁室報曰：「元帥府約束，若兵近夏境，則與夏人相為掎角，毋相侵犯。」
units.en: Loushi replied: "Marshal headquarters has ruled that when our forces approach the Xia border, we and the Xia shall coordinate as allies and not attack each other."
units.literal: Loushi replied: "The marshal's headquarters has ordered that when troops approach the Xia border, Jin and Xia shall act as pincers and not encroach on one another."

units.zh: 李遇使人來曰：「夏國既以天德、雲內歸大國，大國許我陝西北鄙之地，是以至此。」
units.en: Li Yu's envoy said: "Xia has surrendered Tiande and Yunnei to the Great State, and the Great State granted us the northwestern Shaanxi marches—that is why we are here."
units.literal: Li Yu sent a messenger saying: "Since the Xia state has returned Tiande and Yunnei to the Great State, and the Great State granted us the northwestern marches of Shaanxi, we have come here for that reason."

units.zh: 蒲察等遂旋軍。
units.en: Pucha and his forces then withdrew.
units.literal: Pucha and the others thereupon withdrew their armies.

units.zh: 睿宗既定陝西，元帥府不欲以陝西北鄙與夏國，詔曰：「卿等審處所宜從事。」
units.en: Once Emperor Ruizong had secured Shaanxi, marshal headquarters was reluctant to cede the northwestern marches to Xia; an edict said: "You are to weigh what is appropriate and act accordingly."
units.literal: After Emperor Ruizong had pacified Shaanxi, the marshal's headquarters did not wish to give the northwestern marches of Shaanxi to the Xia state; an edict said: "You are to weigh what is appropriate and act accordingly."

units.zh: 天眷二年，國王乾順薨，子仁孝立，遣使冊命，加開府儀同三司上柱國。
units.en: In Tianjuan 2 King Qianshun died and his son Renxiao succeeded. Jin sent envoys to invest him, conferring the ranks of Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Supreme Pillar of State.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianjuan the king Qianshun died; his son Renxiao succeeded; envoys were sent to invest him with the ranks of Kaifu Yitong Sansi and Supreme Pillar of State.

units.zh: 皇統元年，請置榷場、許之。
units.en: In Huangtong 1 they requested a frontier trading post, and the request was approved.
units.literal: In the first year of Huangtong they requested establishment of a frontier market; permission was granted.

units.zh: 初，王阿海等乙太宗誓詔賜夏國，乾順以契丹舊儀見使者，阿海不肯曰：「契丹與夏國甥舅也，故國王坐受，使者以禮進。
units.en: When Wang Ahai first delivered Emperor Taizong's sworn edict to Xia, Qianshun received the envoys by the old Khitan protocol, remaining seated. Ahai objected: "Under the Khitan, Xia was Liao's nephew by marriage, so your king could sit while the envoy performed the rites.
units.literal: At first, when Wang Ahai and others carried Emperor Taizong's sworn edict to bestow on the Xia state, Qianshun received the envoys by the old Khitan protocol, seated; Ahai refused, saying: "Khitan and Xia were uncle and nephew by marriage, so the king could sit and receive while the envoy advanced with ceremony.

units.zh: 今大金與夏國君臣也，見大國使者當如儀。」
units.en: Great Jin and Xia are now sovereign and subject; in receiving envoys of the Great State you must observe the proper ceremony."
units.literal: Now Great Jin and the Xia state are sovereign and subject; in receiving envoys of the Great State you must follow the proper rites."

units.zh: 爭數日不能決，於是始起立受焉。
units.en: The dispute lasted several days before Qianshun finally rose to receive the edict standing.
units.literal: They disputed for several days without resolution, and only then did Qianshun first rise to receive standing.

units.zh: 厥後不遣賜生日使，至是始遣使賜之。
units.en: Jin had not previously sent birthday-congratulation envoys; only now were they first dispatched.
units.literal: Afterward birthday-congratulation envoys had not been sent; only now were envoys first dispatched with gifts.

units.zh: 初，慕洧以環州降，及割陝西、河南與宋人，洧奔夏國，夏人以為山訛首領。
units.en: Mu Wei had first surrendered Huan Prefecture to Jin; when Shaanxi and Henan were ceded to Song he fled to Xia, which appointed him a Shan'e chieftain.
units.literal: At first Mu Wei surrendered Huan Prefecture; when Shaanxi and Henan were ceded to the Song, Wei fled to the Xia state, and the Xia made him a Shan'e chieftain.

units.zh: 及撒離喝再定陝西，洧思歸，夏人知之，遂族洧，以表聞，詔書責讓之。
units.en: When Salihua reconquered Shaanxi, Wei sought to return to Jin. Xia discovered his intent, executed his entire clan, and reported the matter; Jin issued a rebuking edict.
units.literal: When Salihua again pacified Shaanxi, Wei wished to return; the Xia learned of it and thereupon exterminated Wei's clan, reporting by memorial; an edict rebuked them.

units.zh: 及海陵弑熙宗，遣使報諭至境上，夏人問曰：「聖德皇帝何為見廢。」
units.en: When Hailing murdered Emperor Xizong and sent envoys to announce the change at the border, the Xia asked: "Why was the Sagely Virtue Emperor deposed?"
units.literal: When Hailing murdered Emperor Xizong and sent envoys with notification to the border, the Xia asked: "Why was the Sagely Virtue Emperor deposed?"

units.zh: 不肯納。
units.en: They refused to admit the envoys.
units.literal: They refused to receive the envoys.

units.zh: 朝廷乃使有司以廢立之故移文報之。
units.en: The court then had the appropriate offices send a formal dispatch explaining the deposition and succession.
units.literal: The court then had the responsible offices send a written communication explaining the reasons for deposition and enthronement.

units.zh: 天德二年七月，夏使御史中丞雜辣公濟等來賀，如舊禮。
units.en: In the seventh month of Tiande 2, Xia envoys led by Censor-in-Chief Zala Gongji came to offer congratulations according to the established rites.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Tiande, Xia envoys including Censor-in-Chief Zala Gongji came to offer congratulations, following the old protocol.

units.zh: 正隆末伐宋，宋人入秦、隴，夏亦乘隙攻取盪羌、通峽、九羊、會川等城寨，宋亦侵入夏境。
units.en: At the end of Zhenglong Jin campaigned against Song; Song forces entered Qin and Long, and Xia also seized the opportunity to capture the fortresses of Dangqiang, Tongxia, Jiuyang, Huichuan, and others. Song also invaded Xia territory.
units.literal: At the end of Zhenglong Jin campaigned against Song; Song forces entered Qin and Long, and Xia also seized the opportunity to capture the fortresses of Dangqiang, Tongxia, Jiuyang, Huichuan, and others; Song also invaded Xia territory.

units.zh: 世宗即位，夏人復以城寨來歸，且乞兵復宋侵地，詔書嘉奬，仍遣吏部郎中完顏達吉體究陝西利害。
units.en: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, Xia again returned the fortresses and also requested troops to recover territory seized by Song. An edict commended them, and Wanyan Daji, a director in the Ministry of Personnel, was sent to investigate the situation in Shaanxi.
units.literal: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, Xia again returned the fortresses and also requested troops to recover territory seized by Song; an edict commended them, and Wanyan Daji, a director in the Ministry of Personnel, was sent to investigate advantages and disadvantages in Shaanxi.

units.zh: 邊吏奏，夏人已歸城寨，而所侵掠人口財畜尚未還，請索之。
units.en: Border officials memorialized that although Xia had returned the fortresses, the people, livestock, and goods they had plundered had not yet been restored, and requested that recovery be demanded.
units.literal: Border officials memorialized that although Xia had returned the fortresses, the people, livestock, and goods they had plundered had not yet been restored, and requested that recovery be demanded.

units.zh: 大定四年二月甲申，夏遣其武功大夫紐臥文忠等賀萬春節，入見，附狀奏告，略曰：「眾軍破蕩之時，幸而免者十無一二，繼以凍餒死亡，其存幾何。
units.en: On jiazi day in the second month of Dading 4, Xia sent Military Merit Grand Master Niuwo Wenzhong and others to congratulate the Wan Spring Festival. They entered audience and submitted a memorial report, which in summary said: "When the armies were broken and scattered, scarcely one in ten escaped; afterward came deaths from cold and hunger—how many remain?
units.literal: On jiazi day in the second month of Dading 4, Xia sent Military Merit Grand Master Niuwo Wenzhong and others to congratulate the Wan Spring Festival; they entered audience and submitted a memorial report, which in summary said: "When the armies were broken and scattered, scarcely one in ten escaped; afterward came deaths from cold and hunger—how many remain?

units.zh: 兼夏國與宋兵交，人畜之被俘僇亦多，連歲勤動，士卒暴露，勢皆朘削。
units.en: Moreover, as Xia has clashed with Song forces, many people and livestock have been captured and slaughtered. Year after year the troops have been kept in the field, exposed to the elements, and their strength has been worn down.
units.literal: Moreover, as the Xia state has clashed with Song forces, many people and livestock have been captured and slaughtered; year after year the troops have been kept in the field, exposed to the elements, and their strength has all been worn down.

units.zh: 又坐為宋人牽制，使忠誠之節無繇自達，中外咸知，願止約理索，聽納臣言，不勝下國之幸。」
units.en: Further, because we are constrained by the Song, our loyal intent has had no means of making itself known—this is known within and without. We beg that recovery-by-agreement demands be halted and that Your subject's words be heeded—this would be the utmost good fortune of our lesser state."
units.literal: Further, because we are constrained by the Song, our loyal intent has had no means of making itself known—this is known within and without. We beg that recovery-by-agreement demands be halted and that Your subject's words be heeded—this would be the utmost good fortune of our lesser state."

units.zh: 其後屢以為請，詔許之。
units.en: Thereafter they repeatedly made the same request, and an edict granted it.
units.literal: Thereafter they repeatedly made the same request, and an edict granted it.

units.zh: 久之，其臣任得敬專國政，欲分割夏國。
units.en: In time his minister Ren Dejing seized control of government and sought to carve up the Xia state.
units.literal: After a long time his minister Ren Dejing monopolized state power and wished to partition the Xia state.

units.zh: 因賀大定八年正旦，遣奏告使殿前太尉芭裏昌祖等以仁孝章乞良醫為得敬治疾，詔保全郎王師道佩銀牌往焉。
units.en: When congratulating the New Year of Dading 8, Xia sent memorial envoys led by Palace Commander Balichangzu with a petition from Renxiao requesting a skilled physician for Dejing's illness. An edict ordered Preservation Officer Wang Shidao, bearing a silver tablet, to proceed.
units.literal: On the occasion of congratulating the New Year of the eighth year of Dading, he sent memorial envoys including Palace Commander Balichangzu with a memorial from Renxiao requesting a skilled physician to treat Dejing's illness; an edict ordered Preservation Officer Wang Shidao, bearing a silver tablet, to go.

units.zh: 詔師道曰：「如病勢不可療，則勿治。
units.en: The edict instructed Shidao: "If the illness is beyond cure, do not treat it.
units.literal: The edict told Shidao: "If the illness cannot be treated, then do not treat it.

units.zh: 如可治，期一月歸。」
units.en: If it can be treated, return within one month."
units.literal: If it can be treated, return within one month."

units.zh: 得敬疾有瘳，遣謝恩使任得聰來，得敬亦附表進禮物，上曰：「得敬自有定分，附表禮物皆不可受。」
units.en: When Dejing recovered somewhat, he sent gratitude envoy Ren Decong, and Dejing also attached a memorial with gifts. The emperor said: "Dejing has his allotted fate; neither the memorial nor the gifts may be accepted."
units.literal: When Dejing's illness improved somewhat, he sent a gratitude envoy Ren Decong, and Dejing also attached a memorial presenting gifts. The emperor said: "Dejing has his allotted fate; the attached memorial and gifts must none of them be accepted."

units.zh: 並卻之。
units.en: All were declined.
units.literal: All were refused.

units.zh: 初，仁孝嗣位，其臣屢作亂，任得敬抗禦有功，遂相夏二十餘年，陰蓄異志，欲圖夏國，誣殺宗親大臣，其勢漸逼，仁孝不能制。
units.en: When Renxiao first succeeded, his ministers rebelled repeatedly; Ren Dejing distinguished himself in suppressing them and served as chief minister for more than twenty years. He secretly harbored ambitions against the state, executed imperial kinsmen and high officials on false charges, and grew so powerful that Renxiao could no longer restrain him.
units.literal: At first, when Renxiao succeeded to the throne, his ministers repeatedly rebelled; Ren Dejing had merit in resisting them and served as chief minister of Xia for more than twenty years, secretly harboring divergent aims and plotting against the Xia state, falsely executing imperial clansmen and great ministers; his power gradually pressed close and Renxiao could not control him.

units.zh: 大定十年，乃分西南路及靈州羅龐嶺地與得敬，自為國，且上表為得敬求封。
units.en: In Dading 10 he carved off the Southwest Circuit and the Luopang Ridge region of Ling Prefecture for Dejing, who proclaimed himself a separate ruler, and submitted a memorial asking Jin to enfeoff him.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Dading he partitioned off the Southwest Circuit and the Luopang Ridge lands of Ling Prefecture for Dejing, who set himself up as a separate state, and moreover submitted a memorial requesting enfeoffment for Dejing.

units.zh: 世宗以問宰相，尚書令李石等曰：「事系彼國，我何預焉，不如因而許之。」
units.en: Emperor Shizong consulted his chief ministers. Grand Secretary Li Shi and others said: "This is their internal affair—why should we interfere? Better to grant the request."
units.literal: Emperor Shizong asked the chief ministers; Grand Secretary Li Shi and others said: "This concerns their state—what have we to do with it? Better to grant it accordingly."

units.zh: 上曰：「有國之主豈肯無故分國與人，此必權臣逼奪，非夏王本意。
units.en: The emperor replied: "Would any sovereign willingly cede his realm without cause? This must be a powerful minister seizing power by force—not the Xia king's true will.
units.literal: The emperor said: "Would the sovereign of a state willingly partition his realm for no reason and give it to another? This must be a powerful minister forcing seizure—it is not the Xia king's true intent.

units.zh: 況夏國稱籓歲久，一旦迫於賊臣，朕為四海主，甯容此邪？
units.en: Xia has been our vassal for many years; shall I, sovereign of all under Heaven, stand by while a traitorous minister forces its partition?
units.literal: Moreover, the Xia state has been a vassal for many years; suddenly pressed by a treacherous minister—how could I, lord of all within the four seas, tolerate this?

units.zh: 若彼不能自正，則當以兵誅之，不可許也。」
units.en: If they cannot correct this themselves, we shall send troops to punish the traitor—the request cannot be granted."
units.literal: If they cannot set themselves right, then troops should be sent to punish him—it cannot be granted."

units.zh: 乃卻其貢物，賜仁孝詔曰：「自我國家戡定中原，懷柔西土，始則畫疆于乃父，繼而錫命於爾躬，恩厚一方，年垂三紀，籓臣之禮既務踐修，先業所傳亦當固守。
units.en: Their tribute was refused, and an edict was sent to Renxiao: "Since Our dynasty pacified the Central Plain and embraced the western lands, we first drew your father's borders, then invested you personally. For nearly three decades we have shown you deep favor; you have diligently observed vassal rites, and the patrimony you inherited must be firmly upheld.
units.literal: Their tribute gifts were refused, and an edict was bestowed on Renxiao saying: "Since Our state pacified the Central Plain and embraced the western lands, first borders were drawn for your father, then commands were bestowed on your person; grace has been deep in your region for nearly three decades; vassal rites have been diligently practiced, and the patrimony handed down should also be firmly held.

units.zh: 今茲請命，事頗靡常，未知措意之由來，續當遣使以詢爾。
units.en: This present request is most irregular; we do not know what prompted it, and shall send envoys to inquire of you.
units.literal: This present request is quite irregular; we do not know the source of your intent, and shall later send envoys to inquire of you.

units.zh: 所有貢物，已令發回。」
units.en: All tribute goods have been ordered returned."
units.literal: All tribute goods have been ordered sent back."

units.zh: 得敬密通宋人求助，宋以蠟丸書答得敬，夏人得之。
units.en: Dejing secretly appealed to Song for help; Song replied in a wax-sealed message, which Xia intercepted.
units.literal: Dejing secretly communicated with the Song to seek aid; Song replied to Dejing with a letter in a wax pellet, which the Xia obtained.

units.zh: 得敬始因求醫附表進禮物，欲以嘗試世宗，既不可行，而求封又不可得，仁孝乃謀誅之。
units.en: Dejing had first used the medical mission to present gifts and test Emperor Shizong's intentions; when that failed and enfeoffment was denied, Renxiao plotted his execution.
units.literal: Dejing had first, under the pretext of seeking a physician, attached a memorial presenting gifts to test Emperor Shizong; when that could not succeed and enfeoffment also could not be obtained, Renxiao then plotted to execute him.

units.zh: 八月晦，仁孝誅得敬及其黨與，上表謝，並以所執宋人及蠟丸書來上。
units.en: On the last day of the eighth month Renxiao executed Dejing and his followers, submitted a memorial of thanks, and forwarded the captured Song agents and the wax-sealed letter.
units.literal: On the last day of the eighth month Renxiao executed Dejing and his faction, submitted a memorial of thanks, and also sent up the Song men they had seized and the wax-pellet letter.

units.zh: 其謝表曰：「得敬初受分土之後，曾遣使赴大朝代求封建，蒙詔書不為俞納，此朝廷憐愛之恩，夏國不勝感戴。
units.en: The memorial of thanks read: "After Dejing received his partitioned lands he once sent envoys to the Great Court requesting enfeoffment; your edict refused approval—this was the court's compassionate grace, for which Xia is profoundly grateful.
units.literal: The memorial of thanks said: "After Dejing first received his partitioned lands, he once sent envoys to the Great Court to request enfeoffment; we received an edict refusing approval—this was the court's compassionate grace, which the Xia state cannot sufficiently requite in gratitude.

units.zh: 夏國妄煩朝廷，冒求賊臣封建，深虧禮節。
units.en: Xia presumptuously troubled the court by seeking enfeoffment for a traitor—a grave breach of propriety.
units.literal: The Xia state presumptuously troubled the court, daring to seek enfeoffment for a treacherous minister—deeply violating propriety.

units.zh: 今既賊臣誅訖，大朝不用遣使詢問。
units.en: Now that the traitor has been executed, the Great Court need not send envoys to inquire.
units.literal: Now that the treacherous minister has been executed, the Great Court need not send envoys to inquire.

units.zh: 得敬所分之地與大朝熙秦路接境，恐自分地以來別有生事，已根勘禁約，乞朝廷亦行禁約。」
units.en: Dejing's partitioned lands border Jin's Xi-Qin Circuit; fearing further incidents since the partition, we have investigated and imposed restrictions—we beg the court to impose matching restrictions as well."
units.literal: The lands Dejing partitioned border the Great Court's Xi-Qin Circuit; fearing that since the partition other incidents may arise, we have thoroughly investigated and imposed prohibitions—we beg the court also to impose prohibitions."

units.zh: 十二年，上謂宰臣曰：「夏國以珠玉易我絲帛，是以無用易我有用也。」
units.en: In the twelfth year the emperor told his ministers: "Xia trades pearls and jade for our silk and cloth—they exchange what is useless to them for what is useful to us."
units.literal: In the twelfth year the emperor told the chief ministers: "The Xia state exchanges pearls and jade for our silk and cloth—they trade what is useless for what is useful to us."

units.zh: 乃減罷保安、蘭州榷場。
units.en: The frontier markets at Bao'an and Lanzhou were then scaled back and closed.
units.literal: Thereupon the frontier markets at Bao'an and Lanzhou were reduced and abolished.

units.zh: 仁孝深念世宗恩厚，十七年，獻本國所造百頭帳，上曰：「夏國貢獻自有方物，可卻之。」
units.en: Renxiao deeply appreciated Emperor Shizong's generosity; in the seventeenth year he presented a hundred-headed tent of Xia manufacture. The emperor said: "Xia's tribute has its established categories; this may be declined."
units.literal: Renxiao deeply remembered Emperor Shizong's generous grace; in the seventeenth year he presented a hundred-headed tent made in his state. The emperor said: "The Xia state's tribute has its established goods; this may be refused."

units.zh: 仁孝再以表上曰：「所進帳本非珍異，使人亦已到邊，若不蒙包納，則下國深誠無所展效，四方鄰國以為夏國不預大朝眷愛之數，將何所安。」
units.en: Renxiao submitted another memorial: "The tent presented is not especially rare, and our envoys have already reached the border. If it is not accepted, our lesser state has no way to express its sincerity, and neighboring states will think Xia no longer enjoys the Great Court's favor—how could we bear that?"
units.literal: Renxiao again submitted a memorial saying: "The tent presented is not in itself rare or exotic, and the envoys have already reached the border; if it is not accepted, our lesser state has no way to show its deep sincerity, and neighboring states on all sides will think the Xia state is not among those the Great Court favors—how could we be at ease?"

units.zh: 乃許與正旦使同來。
units.en: Permission was then granted for it to arrive with the New Year envoys.
units.literal: Permission was then granted for it to come together with the New Year envoys.

units.zh: 先是，尚書奏：「夏國與陝西邊民私相越境，盜竊財畜，姦人託名榷場貿易，得以往來，恐為邊患。
units.en: Previously the Department of State Affairs memorialized: "The Xia state and Shaanxi border people have been crossing the frontier in secret, stealing livestock and goods. Scoundrels trade under the pretense of frontier-market commerce and thereby come and go—we fear this will become a border threat.
units.literal: Previously the Department of State Affairs memorialized: "The Xia state and the border populace of Shaanxi have been crossing the frontier in secret, stealing livestock and goods. Scoundrels trade under the pretense of frontier-market commerce and thereby come and go—we fear this will become a border calamity.

units.zh: 使人入境與富商相易，亦可禁止。」
units.en: Envoys entering the interior to barter with wealthy merchants should also be prohibited."
units.literal: Envoys entering the interior to barter with wealthy merchants should also be prohibited."

units.zh: 於是，復罷綏德榷場，止存東勝、環州而已。
units.en: The Suide frontier market was then abolished again, leaving only Dongsheng and Huan Prefecture.
units.literal: Thereupon the Suide frontier market was abolished again; only Dongsheng and Huan Prefecture remained.

units.zh: 仁孝表請復置蘭州、保安、綏德榷場如舊，并乞使人入界相易用物。
units.en: Renxiao submitted a memorial requesting restoration of the Lanzhou, Bao'an, and Suide frontier markets as before, and also asked that envoys be permitted to enter the frontier to barter goods.
units.literal: Renxiao submitted a memorial requesting restoration of the Lanzhou, Bao'an, and Suide frontier markets as before, and also petitioned that envoys be permitted to enter the frontier to barter goods.

units.zh: 詔曰：「保安、蘭州地無絲枲，惟綏德建關市以通貨財。
units.en: An edict said: "Bao'an and Lanzhou have no hemp or silk; only at Suide shall a frontier market be established to circulate goods and wealth.
units.literal: An edict said: "Bao'an and Lanzhou have no hemp or silk; only at Suide shall a frontier market be established to circulate goods and wealth.

units.zh: 使副往來，聽留都亭貿易。」
units.en: Envoys coming and going may stay and trade at Duting."
units.literal: Envoys coming and going may stay and trade at Duting."

units.zh: 章宗即位，詔曰：「夏使舘內貿易且已。」
units.en: When Emperor Zhangzong succeeded, an edict said: "Trade by Xia envoys within the guest quarters is henceforth ended."
units.literal: When Emperor Zhangzong succeeded, an edict said: "Trade by Xia envoys within the guest quarters is henceforth ended."

units.zh: 明昌二年，復舊。
units.en: In Mingchang 2 the earlier arrangements were restored.
units.literal: In the second year of Mingchang the earlier arrangements were restored.

units.zh: 頃之，夏人肆牧於鎮戎之境，邏卒逐之，夏人執邏卒而去。
units.en: Before long Xia herded livestock in the Zhenrong marches; border troops drove them off, and Xia seized the border troops and took them away.
units.literal: Before long Xia herded livestock in the Zhenrong marches; border troops drove them off, and Xia seized the border troops and took them away.

units.zh: 邊將阿魯帶率兵詰之，夏廂官吳明契、信陵都、卜祥、徐餘立等伏兵三千於澗中，阿魯帶口中流矢而死，取其弓甲而去。
units.en: Border general A Ludai led troops to interrogate them; Xia vice-prefecture officers Wu Mingqi, Xinlindu, Bu Xiang, and Xu Yuli lay in ambush with three thousand men in a ravine. A Ludai took an arrow in the mouth and died, and they took his bow and armor and withdrew.
units.literal: Border general A Ludai led troops to interrogate them; Xia vice-prefecture officer Wu Mingqi, Xinlindu, Bu Xiang, Xu Yuli, and others lay in ambush with three thousand men in a ravine; A Ludai took an arrow in the mouth and died, and they took his bow and armor and departed.

units.zh: 詔索殺阿魯帶者，夏人處以徒刑，詔索之不已，夏人乃殺明契等。
units.en: An edict demanded those who had killed A Ludai; Xia punished them with penal servitude. When demands continued unabated, Xia then executed Mingqi and the others.
units.literal: An edict demanded those who had killed A Ludai; Xia punished them with penal servitude. When the edict's demands continued unabated, Xia then executed Mingqi and the others.

units.zh: 明昌四年，仁孝薨，子純佑嗣立。
units.en: In Mingchang 4 Renxiao died and his son Chunyou succeeded him.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Mingchang Renxiao died; his son Chunyou succeeded.

units.zh: 承安二年，複置蘭州、保安榷場。
units.en: In Cheng'an 2 the Lanzhou and Bao'an frontier markets were re-established.
units.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an the Lanzhou and Bao'an frontier markets were re-established.

units.zh: 承安五年，純佑母病風求醫，詔太醫判官時德元及王利貞往，仍賜禦藥。
units.en: In Cheng'an 5 Chunyou's mother suffered a stroke and sought medical aid; an edict dispatched Senior Imperial Physicians Shideyuan and Wang Lizhen, along with imperial medicine.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Cheng'an Chunyou's mother suffered wind illness and sought a physician; an edict ordered Senior Imperial Physicians Shideyuan and Wang Lizhen to go, and imperial medicine was also bestowed.

units.zh: 八月，再賜醫藥。
units.en: In the eighth month medicine was sent again.
units.literal: In the eighth month medicine was again bestowed.

units.zh: 泰和六年三月，仁孝弟仁友子安全，廢純佑自立，再閱月死於廢所。
units.en: In the third month of Taihe 6, Renxiao's nephew Anquan, son of Renyou, deposed Chunyou and seized the throne; one month later Chunyou died in confinement.
units.literal: In the third month of the sixth year of Taihe, Renxiao's younger brother Renyou's son Anquan deposed Chunyou and installed himself; one month later Chunyou died in the place of his deposition.

units.zh: 七月，使純佑母羅氏為表，言純佑不能嗣守，與大臣定議立安全為王，遣使奏告。
units.en: In the seventh month Chunyou's mother Lady Luo submitted a memorial stating that Chunyou could not maintain the throne, that she and the chief ministers had agreed to install Anquan as king, and envoys were dispatched to report the change.
units.literal: In the seventh month Chunyou's mother Lady Luo was made to submit a memorial stating that Chunyou could not succeed and hold the throne, that she and the great ministers had decided to install Anquan as king, and envoys were sent to report.

units.zh: 夏使私問館伴官：「奏告事詔許否？」
units.en: The Xia envoy privately asked the escort officer: "Has the memorial report been approved?"
units.literal: The Xia envoy privately asked the escort officer: "Has the memorial report been approved by edict?"

units.zh: 館伴官曰：「此不當問也。」
units.en: The escort officer replied: "That is not for you to ask."
units.literal: The escort officer said: "That is not something you should ask."

units.zh: 夏使曰：「明日當問諸客省，若又不答，則升殿奏請。」
units.en: The Xia envoy said: "Tomorrow I shall ask the Reception Office; if they refuse again, I shall petition before the throne."
units.literal: The Xia envoy said: "Tomorrow I shall ask the Reception Office; if they again do not answer, I shall ascend the hall and petition."

units.zh: 上聞之，使客省諭以許所祈之意，乃賜羅氏詔詢其意，夏人複以羅氏表來，乃封安全為夏國王。
units.en: When the emperor heard of this, he had the Reception Office inform them that their request was granted, then sent an edict to Lady Luo inquiring of her intent. When Xia submitted Lady Luo's memorial again, Anquan was enfeoffed as King of Xia.
units.literal: When the emperor heard of it, he had the Reception Office inform them that their request was granted, then bestowed an edict on Lady Luo inquiring of her intent; the Xia again sent Lady Luo's memorial, and Anquan was enfeoffed as King of Xia.

units.zh: 大安三年，安全薨，族子遵頊立。
units.en: In Da'an 3 Anquan died, and his clansman Zunxu succeeded.
units.literal: In the third year of Da'an Anquan died, and his clansman Zunxu succeeded.

units.zh: 遵頊先以狀元及第，充大都督府主，立在安全薨前一月，衞紹王無實錄，不知其故。
units.en: Zunxu had previously passed the examinations as zhuangyuan and served as Director of the Metropolitan Grand Commandery Office. He was enthroned one month before Anquan died—the Veritable Records for Prince Shao of Wei do not explain why.
units.literal: Zunxu had previously passed the examinations as zhuangyuan and served as Director of the Metropolitan Grand Commandery Office; he was enthroned one month before Anquan died—the Veritable Records for Prince Shao of Wei do not explain why.

units.zh: 然是時金兵敗績于會河堡，夏人乘其兵敗侵略邊境，而通使如故。
units.en: Yet at that time Jin forces suffered defeat at Huihe Fort; Xia seized on their defeat to raid the border, while diplomatic exchanges continued as before.
units.literal: Yet at that time Jin forces suffered defeat at Huihe Fort; Xia seized on their defeat to raid the border, while diplomatic exchanges continued as before.

units.zh: 崇慶元年三月，攻葭州。
units.en: In the third month of Chongqing 1 they attacked Jia Prefecture.
units.literal: In the third month of the first year of Chongqing they attacked Jia Prefecture.

units.zh: 至甯元年六月，攻保安州。
units.en: In the sixth month of Zhiyong 1 they attacked Bao'an Prefecture.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhiyong they attacked Bao'an Prefecture.

units.zh: 貞祐元年十一月，攻會州，都統徒單醜兒擊走之。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Zhenyou 1 they attacked Huizhou; Commander Tudan Chou'er drove them off.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Zhenyou they attacked Huizhou; Commander Tudan Chou'er routed them.

units.zh: 十二月，陷涇州。
units.en: In the twelfth month they captured Jing Prefecture.
units.literal: In the twelfth month they captured Jing Prefecture.

units.zh: 二年八月，歸國人喬成齎夏國書，大概言金邊吏侵略，乞禁戢。
units.en: In the eighth month of the second year the repatriated subject Qiao Cheng delivered a Xia letter complaining that Jin border officials were encroaching and begging that they be restrained.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the second year the returned subject Qiao Cheng carried a letter from the Xia state, stating in general that Jin border officials were encroaching and begging that they be restrained.

units.zh: 詔移文答之，宰臣言：「既非公牒，今將責問，彼必飾詞，徒為虛文，無益於事。」
units.en: An edict ordered a written reply; the chief ministers said: "Since this is not an official dispatch, if we press them for answers they will only dress up their excuses—empty formalities that accomplish nothing."
units.literal: An edict ordered a written reply; the chief ministers said: "Since it is not an official dispatch, if we now hold them accountable they will certainly dress up their words—it would be empty formality without benefit to the matter."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: The matter was then dropped.
units.literal: The matter was then dropped.

units.zh: 未幾，夏人攻慶原、延安、積石州，乃詔有司移文責問。
units.en: Soon afterward Xia forces attacked Qingyuan, Yan'an, and Jishi Prefecture, and the court ordered a formal written rebuke.
units.literal: Before long the Xia attacked Qingyuan, Yan'an, and Jishi Prefecture, and an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written rebukes.

units.zh: 十一月，蘭州譯人程陳僧結夏人以州叛，邊將敗其兵三千。
units.en: In the eleventh month Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng colluded with Xia forces to rebel with the prefecture; border generals defeated three thousand of their troops.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the Lanzhou interpreter Cheng Chenseng joined with Xia men to rebel with the prefecture; border generals defeated three thousand of their troops.

units.zh: 三年正月，夏兵攻武延川，宣宗曰：「此不足慮，恐由他道入也。」
units.en: In the first month of the third year Xia troops attacked Wuyanchuan. Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is no great concern—they may be entering by another route."
units.literal: In the first month of the third year Xia troops attacked Wuyanchuan; Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is not worth worrying about—fear that they may enter by another route."

units.zh: 既而聞邊吏侵夏境，夏人乃攻環州，詔治邊吏罪。
units.en: Soon afterward it was learned that Jin border officials had encroached on Xia territory; Xia then attacked Huan Prefecture, and an edict ordered the border officials punished.
units.literal: Soon afterward it was learned that border officials had encroached on Xia territory; the Xia then attacked Huan Prefecture, and an edict ordered punishment of the border officials.

units.zh: 夏兵攻積石州，都統姜伯通敗之。
units.en: Xia troops attacked Jishi Prefecture; Commander Jiang Botong defeated them.
units.literal: Xia troops attacked Jishi Prefecture; Commander Jiang Botong defeated them.

units.zh: 夏兵入安鄉關，都統曹記僧、萬戶忽三十卻之。
units.en: Xia troops entered Anxiang Pass; Commanders Cao Jiseng and the ten-thousand-household officer Hu Sanshi drove them back.
units.literal: Xia troops entered Anxiang Pass; Commanders Cao Jiseng and the ten-thousand-household officer Hu Sanshi repulsed them.

units.zh: 二月，攻環州，刺史烏古論延壽敗之於境上。
units.en: In the second month they attacked Huan Prefecture; Prefect Wugulun Yanshou defeated them at the frontier.
units.literal: In the second month they attacked Huan Prefecture; Prefect Wugulun Yanshou defeated them on the border.

units.zh: 三月，詔議伐夏，陝西宣撫司奏：「往者，夏人侵我環、慶，河、蘭、積石以兵應之，悉皆遁去，遽還巢穴，蓋為我備也。
units.en: In the third month the court debated a campaign against Xia. The Shaanxi Pacification Commission reported: "When Xia invaded our Huan and Qing circuits in the past, He, Lan, and Jishi responded with troops and the enemy fled straight back to their lairs—they were on guard against us.
units.literal: In the third month an edict ordered discussion of campaigning against Xia; the Shaanxi Pacification Commission memorialized: "In the past, when Xia men invaded our Huan and Qing circuits, He, Lan, and Jishi responded with troops and they all fled, swiftly returning to their lairs—this was because they were on guard against us.

units.zh: 今蘭州潰兵猶未集，軍實多不完，沿邊地寒，春草始生，未可芻牧，兩界無煙火者三百餘裏，不宜輕舉。」
units.en: Lanzhou's scattered troops have not yet reassembled, supplies are incomplete, the frontier is still cold, spring grass has only just sprouted and cannot yet feed herds, and for more than three hundred li along both borders there is no habitation—a rash campaign is inadvisable."
units.literal: Now Lanzhou's scattered troops have not yet been gathered, military stores are largely incomplete, the borderlands are cold, spring grass has only begun to grow and cannot yet be cut for fodder, and for more than three hundred li on both sides there is no sign of habitation—it is not fitting to act rashly."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court accepted this advice.
units.literal: The memorial was followed.

units.zh: 四月，詔河州提控曹記僧、通遠軍節度使完顏狗兒討程陳僧，夏人援之。
units.en: In the fourth month an edict ordered Hezhou Controller Cao Jiseng and Tongyuan Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Gou'er to suppress Cheng Chenseng; Xia forces came to his aid.
units.literal: In the fourth month an edict ordered Hezhou Controller Cao Jiseng and Tongyuan Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Gou'er to suppress Cheng Chenseng; the Xia came to his aid.

units.zh: 九月，遂破西關堡。
units.en: In the ninth month they captured Xiguan Fort.
units.literal: In the ninth month they then captured Xiguan Fort.

units.zh: 夏人複攻第五將城，萬戶楊再興擊走之。
units.en: Xia forces again attacked the Fifth Commandery city; the ten-thousand-household officer Yang Zaixing drove them off.
units.literal: The Xia again attacked the Fifth Commandery city; the ten-thousand-household officer Yang Zaixing drove them off.

units.zh: 詔陝西宣撫司及沿邊諸將，降空名宣敕，臨陣立功，五品以下並聽遷授。
units.en: An edict authorized the Shaanxi Pacification Commission and border generals to issue blank appointment edicts: officers of fifth rank and below who distinguished themselves in battle could be promoted on the spot.
units.literal: An edict ordered the Shaanxi Pacification Commission and border generals to issue blank-name edicts of appointment: those who achieved merit in battle, fifth rank and below, were all permitted promotion.

units.zh: 十月，攻保安及延安，都統完顏國家奴破之。
units.en: In the tenth month they attacked Bao'an and Yan'an; Commander Wanyan Guojianu defeated them.
units.literal: In the tenth month they attacked Bao'an and Yan'an; Commander Wanyan Guojianu defeated them.

units.zh: 既而深入臨洮，總管陀滿胡土門不能禦，陝西宣撫副使完顏胡失來救臨洮，大敗於渭源堡，城破，胡失來被執。
units.en: They then pushed deep into Lintao; Commander Tuoman Hutumen could not hold them. Shaanxi Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Hushilai marched to relieve Lintao but was routed at Weiyuan Fort; the city fell and Hushilai was captured.
units.literal: They then penetrated deep into Lintao; Commander Tuoman Hutumen could not withstand them. Shaanxi Pacification Vice Commissioner Wanyan Hushilai came to rescue Lintao but suffered a great defeat at Weiyuan Fort; the city fell and Hushilai was captured.

units.zh: 十一月，夏兵敗於克戎寨，複敗於熟羊寨，宰相入賀，宣宗曰：「此忠賢之力也。」
units.en: In the eleventh month Xia troops were defeated at Kerong Stockade and again at Shuyang Stockade. The chief ministers came to congratulate him, and Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is the work of loyal servants."
units.literal: In the eleventh month Xia troops were defeated at Kerong Stockade and again at Shuyang Stockade; the chief ministers entered to offer congratulations, and Emperor Xuanzong said: "This is the power of loyal worthies."

units.zh: 夏兵進圍臨洮，陀滿胡土門破之。
units.en: Xia troops advanced to besiege Lintao; Tuoman Hutumen defeated them.
units.literal: Xia troops advanced to besiege Lintao; Tuoman Hutumen defeated them.

units.zh: 四年四月，夏葩俄族總管汪三郎率眾來降，進羊千口，詔納之，優給其直。
units.en: In the fourth month of the fourth year Xia Pa'e tribe Commander Wang Sanlang surrendered with his followers, presenting a thousand sheep; the court accepted them and paid generously.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year Xia Pa'e tribe Commander Wang Sanlang led his followers to surrender, presenting a thousand sheep; an edict accepted them and generously paid their value.

units.zh: 來遠鎮獲諜人，言宋、夏相結來攻，詔陝西行省備之。
units.en: Laiyuan Town captured a spy reporting that Song and Xia had allied to attack; an edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to prepare defenses.
units.literal: Laiyuan Town captured a spy who said Song and Xia had joined to attack; an edict ordered the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat to prepare.

units.zh: 夏於來羌城界河起折橋，元帥右都監完顏賽不焚之，斬馘甚眾。
units.en: Xia built a pontoon bridge across the border river at Laicheng; Marshal Right Controller Wanyan Saibu burned it and killed many of the enemy.
units.literal: The Xia built a pontoon bridge across the border river at Laicheng; Marshal Right Controller Wanyan Saibu burned it and killed many.

units.zh: 六月，鄜延路奏，夏人牒報用彼國光定年號，詔封還其牒。
units.en: In the sixth month the Fuyan Circuit reported that Xia dispatches used their Guangding reign title; an edict ordered the dispatches sealed and returned unopened.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Fuyan Circuit reported that Xia dispatches used their state's Guangding reign title; an edict ordered the dispatches sealed and returned.

units.zh: 閏月，慶陽總管慶山奴伐夏，出環州，陝西行省請中分其軍，令慶山奴出第三將懷安寨，環州刺史完顏胡魯出環州，宣宗曰：「聞夏人移軍備其王城，尚恐詐我，勿墮其計中也。」
units.en: In the intercalary month Qingyang Commander Qingshannu campaigned against Xia from Huan Prefecture. The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat proposed splitting his army, with Qingshannu advancing from Huaian Stockade of the Third Commandery and Huan Prefect Wanyan Hulu from Huan Prefecture. Emperor Xuanzong said: "I hear Xia has shifted troops to guard their capital—they may still be trying to deceive us; do not fall into their trap."
units.literal: In the intercalary month Qingyang Commander Qingshannu campaigned against Xia, setting out from Huan Prefecture; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat requested dividing his army, ordering Qingshannu out from the Third Commandery's Huaian Stockade and Huan Prefect Wanyan Hulu out from Huan Prefecture. Emperor Xuanzong said: "I hear the Xia have shifted troops to guard their royal city—still fear they may be deceiving us; do not fall into their trap."

units.zh: 提控完顏狗兒抵蘭州西關堡，招得舊部曲九人。
units.en: Controller Wanyan Gou'er reached Lanzhou's Xiguan Fort and recruited nine of his former retainers.
units.literal: Controller Wanyan Gou'er reached Lanzhou's Xiguan Fort and recruited nine of his former retainers.

units.zh: 掩擊夏兵于阿彌灣，殺其將士百餘人。
units.en: He ambushed Xia troops at Ami Bay and killed more than a hundred officers and men.
units.literal: He made a surprise attack on Xia troops at Ami Bay and killed more than a hundred officers and men.

units.zh: 八月，左監軍烏古論慶壽敗夏兵于安塞堡。
units.en: In the eighth month Left Controller Wugulun Qingshou defeated Xia troops at Ansa Fort.
units.literal: In the eighth month Left Controller Wugulun Qingshou defeated Xia troops at Ansa Fort.

units.zh: 右都監賽不擊走夏兵於結耶觜川，複破之于車兒堡。
units.en: Right Controller Saibu drove off Xia troops at Jieyezui Stream and defeated them again at Che'er Fort.
units.literal: Right Controller Saibu drove off Xia troops at Jieyezui Stream and again defeated them at Che'er Fort.

units.zh: 十一月，提控石盞合喜、楊斡烈解定西之圍。
units.en: In the eleventh month Controllers Shizhan Hexi and Yang Wolie lifted the siege of Dingxi.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Controllers Shizhan Hexi and Yang Wolie lifted the siege of Dingxi.

units.zh: 十二月丙寅，宣宗與皇太子議伐夏，左監軍陀滿胡土門、延安總管古裏甲石倫攻鹽、宥、夏州，慶陽總管慶山奴、知平涼府移剌答不也攻威、靈、安、會等州。
units.en: On bingyin of the twelfth month Emperor Xuanzong and the crown prince planned a campaign against Xia: Left Controller Tuoman Hutumen and Yan'an Commander Gulijia Shilun would attack Yan, You, and Xia Prefectures; Qingyang Commander Qingshannu and Pingliang Prefect Yila Dabuye would attack Wei, Ling, An, and Hui Prefectures.
units.literal: On bingyin of the twelfth month Emperor Xuanzong and the crown prince discussed campaigning against Xia: Left Controller Tuoman Hutumen and Yan'an Commander Gulijia Shilun were to attack Yan, You, and Xia Prefectures; Qingyang Commander Qingshannu and Pingliang Prefect Yila Dabuye were to attack Wei, Ling, An, and Hui Prefectures.

units.zh: 興定元年正月，夏兵三萬自寧州還，慶山奴以兵邀擊，敗之。
units.en: In the first month of Xingding 1 thirty thousand Xia troops were returning from Ning Prefecture; Qingshannu intercepted and defeated them.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Xingding thirty thousand Xia troops were returning from Ning Prefecture; Qingshannu intercepted them with troops and defeated them.

units.zh: 詔河東行省胥鼎選兵三萬五千，付陀滿胡土門伐夏，鼎馳奏不可，遂止，語在鼎傳。
units.en: An edict ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xu Ding to select thirty-five thousand troops for Tuoman Hutumen's Xia campaign; Xu Ding urgently memorialized against it and the plan was halted, as recorded in his biography.
units.literal: An edict ordered Hedong Branch Secretariat Xu Ding to select thirty-five thousand troops and hand them to Tuoman Hutumen to campaign against Xia; Xu Ding urgently memorialized that it could not be done, and the matter was stopped—the account is in his biography.

units.zh: 右都監完顏仲元請試兵西夏，出其不意必獲全勝，兵威既振，國力益完。
units.en: Right Controller Wanyan Zhongyuan proposed testing Jin's forces against Western Xia, arguing that a surprise strike would win a complete victory, restore military prestige, and strengthen the state.
units.literal: Right Controller Wanyan Zhongyuan requested trial of troops against Western Xia, saying that striking by surprise would surely win complete victory, military prestige would be aroused, and national strength further perfected.

units.zh: 詔下尚書省、樞密院議。
units.en: An edict referred the proposal to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs for deliberation.
units.literal: An edict referred the matter to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs for discussion.

units.zh: 夏人福山以俘戶來降，除同知澤州軍州事。
units.en: The Xia subject Fushan surrendered with captive households and was appointed Associate Administrator of Ze Prefecture.
units.literal: The Xia man Fushan came over with captive households and was appointed Associate Administrator of Ze Prefecture.

units.zh: 五月，夏兵入大北岔，都統紇石烈豬狗掩擊，敗之。
units.en: In the fifth month Xia troops entered Dabeicha; Commander Geshilie Zhugou ambushed and defeated them.
units.literal: In the fifth month Xia troops entered Dabeicha; Commander Geshilie Zhugou made a surprise attack and defeated them.

units.zh: 宣宗欲與夏議和，右都監慶山奴屯延安，奏曰：「夏國決不肯和，徒見欺耳。」
units.en: Emperor Xuanzong wished to negotiate peace with Xia. Right Controller Qingshannu, stationed at Yan'an, memorialized: "Xia will never agree to peace—we would only be deceived."
units.literal: Emperor Xuanzong wished to negotiate peace with Xia; Right Controller Qingshannu, stationed at Yan'an, memorialized: "The Xia state will certainly not agree to peace—we would only be deceived."

units.zh: 既而，獲諜者言，遵頊聞大金將約和，戒諭將士無犯西鄙。
units.en: Soon afterward a captured spy reported that Zunxian, hearing Jin was about to negotiate peace, had ordered his troops not to violate the western border.
units.literal: Soon afterward a captured spy said that Zunxian, hearing that Great Jin was about to make peace, had admonished his officers and men not to violate the western border.

units.zh: 宰臣奏曰：「就令如此，邊備亦不宜弛。」
units.en: The chief ministers memorialized: "Even if this is true, border defenses must not be relaxed."
units.literal: The chief ministers memorialized: "Even if this is so, border defenses should not be relaxed."

units.zh: 宣宗以為然。
units.en: Emperor Xuanzong agreed.
units.literal: Emperor Xuanzong agreed.

units.zh: 右都監完顏閭山敗夏兵于黃鶴岔。
units.en: Right Controller Wanyan Lüshan defeated Xia troops at Huanghe Pass.
units.literal: Right Controller Wanyan Lüshan defeated Xia troops at Huanghe Pass.

units.zh: 夏人圍羊狠寨，都統黨世昌與戰，完顏狗兒遣都統夾穀瑞夜斫夏營，遂解其圍，猶駐近地，左都監白撒發定西銳兵、龕谷副統包孝成緋翮翅軍，合擊走之。
units.en: Xia forces besieged Yanghen Stockade; Commander Dang Shichang engaged them. Wanyan Gou'er sent Commander Jiagu Rui to raid the Xia camp by night and lift the siege, but the enemy still camped nearby. Left Controller Baisha sent Dingxi elite troops and Longgu Vice Commander Bao Xiaocheng's Crimson-Winged-Wing army, and together they drove the Xia off.
units.literal: Xia men besieged Yanghen Stockade; Commander Dang Shichang fought them. Wanyan Gou'er sent Commander Jiagu Rui to strike the Xia camp by night, lifting the siege, but they still camped nearby; Left Controller Baisha dispatched Dingxi elite troops and Longgu Vice Commander Bao Xiaocheng's Crimson-Winged-Wing army, and together drove them off.

units.zh: 八月，安定堡馬家平總押李公直敗夏兵三千。
units.en: In the eighth month at Anding Fort's Majiaping, Chief Commander Li Gongzhi defeated three thousand Xia troops.
units.literal: In the eighth month at Anding Fort's Majiaping, Chief Commander Li Gongzhi defeated three thousand Xia troops.

units.zh: 九月，都統羅世暉卻夏兵於克戎寨。
units.en: In the ninth month Commander Luo Shihui repulsed Xia troops at Kerong Stockade.
units.literal: In the ninth month Commander Luo Shihui repulsed Xia troops at Kerong Stockade.

units.zh: 興定二年三月，右都監慶山奴奏：「夏人有乞和意，保安、綏德、葭州得文報，乞複互市，以尋舊盟。
units.en: In the third month of Xingding 2 Right Controller Qingshannu reported: "Xia appears willing to sue for peace; Bao'an, Suide, and Jia Prefectures have received written requests to restore mutual trade and renew the old alliance.
units.literal: In the third month of the second year of Xingding Right Controller Qingshannu memorialized: "The Xia show intention to beg peace; Bao'an, Suide, and Jia Prefectures have received written reports asking to restore mutual markets and seek the old alliance.

units.zh: 以臣觀之，此出於遵頊，非邊吏所敢專者。」
units.en: In my view this comes from Zunxian himself—border officials would not dare decide such a matter on their own."
units.literal: In your subject's view, this comes from Zunxian—it is not something border officials would dare decide on their own."

units.zh: 朝廷不以為然。
units.en: The court did not accept this.
units.literal: The court did not accept this.

units.zh: 五月，夏人入葭州，慶山奴破之于馬吉峰。
units.en: In the fifth month Xia forces entered Jia Prefecture; Qingshannu defeated them at Maji Peak.
units.literal: In the fifth month Xia men entered Jia Prefecture; Qingshannu defeated them at Maji Peak.

units.zh: 七月，犯龕谷，夾谷瑞、趙防敗之，追至質孤堡。
units.en: In the seventh month they attacked Longgu; Jiagu Rui and Zhao Fang defeated them and pursued to Zhigu Fort.
units.literal: In the seventh month they violated Longgu; Jiagu Rui and Zhao Fang defeated them and pursued to Zhigu Fort.

units.zh: 三年閏月，夏人破通秦寨，提控納合買住擊敗之，自葭盧川遁去。
units.en: In the intercalary month of the third year Xia forces captured Tongqin Stockade; Controller Nahe Maizhu defeated them and they fled along Jialu Stream.
units.literal: In the intercalary month of the third year Xia men captured Tongqin Stockade; Controller Nahe Maizhu defeated them and they fled away along Jialu Stream.

units.zh: 華州元帥完顏合達出安寨堡至隆州，敗其兵二千。
units.en: Huazhou Marshal Wanyan Heda marched from Anzhai Fort to Long Prefecture and defeated two thousand Xia troops.
units.literal: Huazhou Marshal Wanyan Heda marched from Anzhai Fort to Long Prefecture and defeated two thousand of their troops.

units.zh: 進攻隆州，克其西南，會暮乃還。
units.en: He advanced on Long Prefecture, captured its southwest quarter, and withdrew at dusk.
units.literal: He advanced to attack Long Prefecture, captured its southwest, and returned when evening came.

units.zh: 十二月，詔有司移文夏國。
units.en: In the twelfth month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send a formal dispatch to Xia.
units.literal: In the twelfth month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written communication to the Xia state.

units.zh: 四年二月，夏人犯鎮戎，金師敗績，夏人公移語不遜，詔詞臣草牒折之。
units.en: In the second month of the fourth year Xia forces attacked Zhenrong and Jin suffered defeat. Xia's official dispatch used disrespectful language; an edict ordered court writers to draft a rebuttal.
units.literal: In the second month of the fourth year Xia men violated Zhenrong; Jin forces suffered defeat. The Xia official communication used disrespectful language; an edict ordered literary officials to draft a written reply refuting them.

units.zh: 四月，夏兵犯邊，元帥石盞合喜遇于鹿兒原，提控烏古論世顯以偏師敗之，都統王定複破其眾於新泉城。
units.en: In the fourth month Xia troops raided the border; Marshal Shizhan Hexi met them at Lu'er Plain; Controller Wugulun Shixian routed them with a detached force, and Commander Wang Ding defeated their main body again at Xinquan City.
units.literal: In the fourth month Xia troops violated the border; Marshal Shizhan Hexi met them at Lu'er Plain; Controller Wugulun Shixian with a detached force defeated them, and Commander Wang Ding again broke their host at Xinquan City.

units.zh: 元帥慶山奴攻宥州，圍神堆府，穴其城，士卒有登者，援兵至，擊走之，斬首二千，俘百餘人，獲雜畜三千餘。
units.en: Marshal Qingshannu attacked You Prefecture and besieged Shendui Prefecture, tunneling into the walls until some soldiers scaled them. Relief troops arrived and Jin drove them off, taking two thousand heads, more than a hundred prisoners, and more than three thousand head of livestock.
units.literal: Marshal Qingshannu attacked You Prefecture, besieged Shendui Prefecture, tunneled into its walls, and some soldiers mounted the ramparts; relief troops arrived and they were driven off, with two thousand heads cut off, more than a hundred captives taken, and more than three thousand mixed livestock seized.

units.zh: 八月，夏人陷會州，刺史烏古論世顯降，複犯龕谷，夾谷瑞連戰敗之，夏人乃去。
units.en: In the eighth month Xia captured Huizhou; Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered. They attacked Longgu again; Jiagu Rui defeated them in successive battles and Xia withdrew.
units.literal: In the eighth month Xia men captured Huizhou; Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered. They again violated Longgu; Jiagu Rui defeated them in successive battles and the Xia then withdrew.

units.zh: 是月，詔有司移文議和，事竟不克。
units.en: That month an edict ordered the responsible offices to negotiate peace by written dispatch; the effort ultimately failed.
units.literal: That month an edict ordered the responsible offices to send written communication to discuss peace; the matter in the end did not succeed.

units.zh: 夏人三萬自高峰鎮圍定西，刺史愛申阿失剌、提控烏古論長壽、溫敦永昌擊走之。
units.en: Thirty thousand Xia troops from Gaofeng Town besieged Dingxi; Prefect Aishen Ashila and Controllers Wugulun Changshou and Wendun Yongchang drove them off.
units.literal: Thirty thousand Xia men from Gaofeng Town besieged Dingxi; Prefect Aishen Ashila and Controllers Wugulun Changshou and Wendun Yongchang drove them off.

units.zh: 九月，夏人圍綏平寨、安定堡，未幾，陷西寧州，遂攻定西，烏古論長壽擊卻之。
units.en: In the ninth month Xia besieged Suiping Stockade and Anding Fort; soon they captured Xining Prefecture and then attacked Dingxi; Wugulun Changshou repulsed them.
units.literal: In the ninth month Xia men besieged Suiping Stockade and Anding Fort; before long they captured Xining Prefecture, then attacked Dingxi; Wugulun Changshou repulsed them.

units.zh: 乃襲鞏州，石盞合喜逆戰，一日十余戰，乃解去。
units.en: They then raided Gong Prefecture; Shizhan Hexi met them in battle, fighting more than ten engagements in a single day before they withdrew.
units.literal: They then raided Gong Prefecture; Shizhan Hexi met them in battle, fighting more than ten engagements in one day, and they then withdrew.

units.zh: 五年正月，詔樞密院議夏事，奏曰：「夏人聚兵境上，欲由會州入，已遣行省白撒伏兵險要以待之。
units.en: In the first month of the fifth year the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to discuss Xia affairs; they reported: "Xia is massing troops on the border and intends to enter through Huizhou; Branch Secretariat Baisha has already been sent to set ambushes at strategic passes.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year an edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to discuss Xia affairs; they memorialized: "Xia men are massing troops on the border and wish to enter by Huizhou; the Branch Secretariat Baisha has already been sent to set ambushes at strategic passes to await them.

units.zh: 鄜延元帥府伺便發兵以綴其後，足以無慮。」
units.en: The Fuyan Marshal's headquarters will strike their rear when opportunity arises—there is no cause for alarm."
units.literal: The Fuyan Marshal's headquarters will watch for opportunity to send troops to harass their rear—this is sufficient to be without concern."

units.zh: 二月，甯遠軍節度使夾谷海壽破夏兵於搜嵬堡。
units.en: In the second month Ningyuan Army Military Commissioner Jiagu Haishou defeated Xia troops at Souwei Fort.
units.literal: In the second month Ningyuan Army Military Commissioner Jiagu Haishou defeated Xia troops at Souwei Fort.

units.zh: 三月，復取來羌城。
units.en: In the third month Laicheng was recaptured.
units.literal: In the third month Laicheng was recaptured.

units.zh: 十月，攻龕谷，白撒連敗之。
units.en: In the tenth month they attacked Longgu; Baisha defeated them repeatedly.
units.literal: In the tenth month they attacked Longgu; Baisha defeated them repeatedly.

units.zh: 元光元年正月，夏人陷大通城，複取之。
units.en: In the first month of the first year of Yuanguang Xia captured Datong City; Jin then recaptured it.
units.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanguang Xia men captured Datong City; it was then recaptured.

units.zh: 三月，提控李師林敗夏兵於永木嶺。
units.en: In the third month Controller Li Shilin defeated Xia troops at Yongmu Ridge.
units.literal: In the third month Controller Li Shilin defeated Xia troops at Yongmu Ridge.

units.zh: 八月，攻甯安寨，十月，攻神林堡，十二月，入質孤堡，提控唐括昉敗之。
units.en: In the eighth month they attacked Ning'an Stockade; in the tenth month Shenlin Fort; in the twelfth month they entered Zhigu Fort; Controller Tangguo Fang defeated them.
units.literal: In the eighth month they attacked Ning'an Stockade; in the tenth month they attacked Shenlin Fort; in the twelfth month they entered Zhigu Fort; Controller Tangguo Fang defeated them.

units.zh: 二年，遵頊使其太子德任來伐，德任諫曰：「彼兵勢尚強，不若與之約和。」
units.en: In the second year Zunxian sent his crown prince Deren to campaign against Jin. Deren remonstrated: "Their armies are still strong—we would do better to negotiate peace."
units.literal: In the second year Zunxian sent his crown prince Deren to campaign; Deren remonstrated: "Their military strength is still formidable—it would be better to make peace with them."

units.zh: 遵頊笑曰：「是非爾所知也。
units.en: Zunxian laughed and said: "That is beyond your understanding.
units.literal: Zunxian laughed and said: "That is not for you to know.

units.zh: 彼失蘭州竟不能複，何強之有。」
units.en: They lost Lanzhou and could not even recover it—what strength do they have?"
units.literal: They lost Lanzhou and could not even recover it—where is their strength?"

units.zh: 德任固諫不從，乞避太子位，願為僧。
units.en: Deren remonstrated again but was not heeded; he asked to renounce the crown prince's position and become a monk.
units.literal: Deren firmly remonstrated but was not heeded; he begged to yield the crown prince's position and wished to become a monk.

units.zh: 遵頊怒，幽之靈州，遣人代將，會天旱不果。
units.en: Zunxian was enraged, imprisoned him in Ling Prefecture, and sent another to command in his stead; drought intervened and the campaign did not take place.
units.literal: Zunxian was angry, imprisoned him in Ling Prefecture, and sent another to command in his place; as it happened drought came and the campaign did not take place.

units.zh: 是歲，大元兵問罪夏國，延安、慶原元帥府欲乘夏人之困弊伐之，陝西行省白撒、合達以為不可，乃止。
units.en: That year Great Yuan forces moved against Xia. The Yan'an and Qingyuan Marshal's headquarters wished to strike Xia while they were exhausted, but Shaanxi Branch Secretariat Baisha and Heda objected and the plan was abandoned.
units.literal: That year Great Yuan troops called Xia to account; the Yan'an and Qingyuan Marshal's headquarters wished to take advantage of the Xia's exhaustion to campaign against them, but Shaanxi Branch Secretariat Baisha and Heda held it could not be done, and the matter was stopped.

units.zh: 隴安軍節度使完顏阿鄰日與將士宴飲，不治軍事，夏人乘之，掠民五千余口、牛羊雜畜數萬而去。
units.en: Long'an Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Alin spent his days feasting with his officers and neglected military affairs. Xia took advantage and carried off more than five thousand civilians and tens of thousands of cattle and sheep.
units.literal: Long'an Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Alin daily feasted and drank with officers and men and did not attend to military affairs; the Xia took advantage of this and carried off more than five thousand civilians and tens of thousands of cattle, sheep, and mixed livestock.

units.zh: 自天會議和，八十餘年與夏人未嘗有兵革之事。
units.en: From the peace concluded at Tianhui, Jin and Xia had gone more than eighty years without war.
units.literal: From the peace concluded at Tianhui, for more than eighty years there had never been warfare with the Xia.

units.zh: 及貞祐之初，小有侵掠，以至構難十年不解，一勝一負精銳皆盡，而兩國俱弊。
units.en: By the beginning of Zhenyou there were small raids, leading to ten years of unresolved hostility. Victory and defeat alternated until both sides had exhausted their best troops and both states were worn down.
units.literal: By the beginning of Zhenyou there were small raids, leading to ten years of unresolved hostility; victory and defeat alternated until elite forces were exhausted on both sides and both states were worn down.

units.zh: 是歲，遵頊傳位於子德旺。
units.en: That year Zunxian abdicated in favor of his son Dewang.
units.literal: That year Zunxian transmitted the throne to his son Dewang.

units.zh: 正大元年，和議成，自稱兄弟之國。
units.en: In Zhengda 1 peace was concluded, and the two states styled themselves brothers.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhengda peace was concluded, and they styled themselves brother states.

units.zh: 三年二月，遵頊死，七月，德旺死，嗣立者史失其名。
units.en: In the second month of the third year Zunxian died; in the seventh month Dewang died; the name of his successor is lost to history.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year Zunxian died; in the seventh month Dewang died; the name of the successor is lost to history.

units.zh: 明年，夏國亡。
units.en: The following year the Xia state perished.
units.literal: The following year the Xia state perished.

units.zh: 先是，夏使精方匭匣使王立之來聘，未複命國已亡，詔於京兆安置，充宣差彈壓，主管夏國降戶。
units.en: Earlier, Xia envoy Wang Lizhi, the Jingfang Guiqiashi, had come on a diplomatic mission; before he could report home his state had fallen. An edict settled him in Jingzhao as special commissioner for suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.
units.literal: Earlier, Xia envoy Wang Lizhi, the Jingfang Guiqiashi, had come on a mission of courtesy; before he could report back his state had perished. An edict ordered him settled in Jingzhao, appointed as special commissioner for suppression, in charge of Xia surrendered households.

units.zh: 八年五月，立之妻子三十余口至環州，詔以歸立之，賜以幣帛。
units.en: In the fifth month of the eighth year more than thirty members of Lizhi's family reached Huan Prefecture; an edict reunited them with Lizhi and bestowed silks and cloth.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year more than thirty members of Lizhi's wife and children reached Huan Prefecture; an edict ordered them returned to Lizhi and bestowed silks and cloth.

units.zh: 立之上言，先世本申州人，乞不仕，居申州。
units.en: Lizhi memorialized that his ancestors were originally from Shen Prefecture; he asked to decline office and live in Shen Prefecture.
units.literal: Lizhi submitted a memorial saying his forebears were originally from Shen Prefecture; he begged not to hold office and to reside in Shen Prefecture.

units.zh: 詔如所請，以本官居申州，主管唐、鄧、申、裕等處夏國降戶，聽唐、鄧總帥府節制，給上田千畝、牛具農作雲。
units.en: An edict granted his request; he was to live in Shen Prefecture in his present office, supervising Xia surrendered households in Tang, Deng, Shen, Yu, and elsewhere under the Tang-Deng Marshal's command, with a grant of a thousand mu of superior fields, oxen, and farm tools.
units.literal: An edict granted his request; he was to reside in Shen Prefecture in his present office, supervising Xia surrendered households in Tang, Deng, Shen, Yu, and other places, subject to the Tang-Deng Marshal's headquarters, and was given a thousand mu of superior fields, oxen, farm tools, and the like.

units.zh: 贊曰：夏之立國舊矣，其臣羅世昌譜敘世次稱，元魏衰微，居松州者因以舊姓為托跋氏。
units.en: The encomium says: Xia's founding is ancient. Minister Luo Shichang's genealogical account states that when Northern Wei declined, those dwelling at Song Prefecture took their old surname and became the Tuoba clan.
units.literal: The encomium says: The founding of Xia is ancient. His minister Luo Shichang, in a genealogical account of successive generations, states that when Northern Wei declined, those dwelling at Song Prefecture took their old surname and became the Tuoba clan.

units.zh: 按《唐書》党項八部有托跋部，自党項入居銀、夏之間者號平夏部。
units.en: According to the Book of Tang, among the eight Tangut tribes was the Tuoba tribe; those Tangut who settled between Yin and Xia were called the Pingxia tribe.
