units.literal: According to the Book of Tang, among the eight Tangut tribes there was the Tuoba tribe; those Tangut who entered and dwelt between Yin and Xia were called the Pingxia tribe.

units.zh: 托跋思恭以破黃巢功賜姓李氏，兄弟相繼為節度使，居夏州，在河南。
units.en: Tuoba Sigong received the surname Li for defeating Huang Chao; brothers succeeded one another as military commissioners, dwelling at Xia Prefecture south of the Yellow River.
units.literal: Tuoba Sigong, for merit in defeating Huang Chao, was granted the surname Li; brothers succeeded one another as military commissioners, dwelling at Xia Prefecture south of the Yellow River.

units.zh: 繼遷再立國，元昊始大，乃北渡河，城興州而都之。
units.en: Jiqian re-established the state; Yuanhao first made it great, then crossed the river northward, walled Xing Prefecture, and made it his capital.
units.literal: Jiqian re-established the state; Yuanhao first made it great, then crossed the river northward, walled Xing Prefecture, and made it his capital.

units.zh: 其地初有夏、綏、銀、宥、靈、鹽等州，其後遂取武威、張掖、酒泉、燉煌郡地，南界橫山，東距西河，土宜三種，善水草，宜畜牧，所謂涼州畜牧甲天下者是也。
units.en: Their territory initially comprised Xia, Sui, Yin, You, Ling, Yan, and other prefectures; later they seized Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang. Their southern border was Heng Mountain and their eastern limit the Western River. The soil supported three crops; grass and water were abundant and animal husbandry thrived—hence the saying that Liangzhou pasturage was finest under Heaven.
units.literal: Their territory at first had Xia, Sui, Yin, You, Ling, Yan, and other prefectures; afterward they took the commandery lands of Wuwei, Zhangye, Jiuquan, and Dunhuang. Their southern border was Heng Mountain and their eastern limit the Western River. The soil suited three crops; grass and water were good and animal husbandry thrived—it was what was called the finest pasturage under Heaven in Liang Prefecture.

units.zh: 土堅腴，水清冽，風氣廣莫，民俗強梗尚氣，重然諾，敢戰鬥。
units.en: The soil was firm and fertile, the water clear and pure, the winds harsh and wide; the people were tough and proud, honoring their word and bold in battle.
units.literal: The soil was firm and fertile, the water clear and pure, the winds wide and desolate; the people's customs were tough and spirited, valuing sworn promises and daring in battle.

units.zh: 自漢、唐以水利積谷食邊兵，興州有漢、唐二渠，甘、涼亦各有灌溉，土境雖小，能以富強，地勢然也。
units.en: Since Han and Tang they had used irrigation to store grain and feed border troops; Xing Prefecture had the Han and Tang canals, and Gan and Liang each had irrigation works. Though their territory was small, they could grow rich and strong—such was the advantage of their land.
units.literal: From Han and Tang onward they used waterworks to store grain and feed border troops; Xing Prefecture had the Han and Tang canals, and Gan and Liang each had irrigation as well. Though their territory was small, they could be rich and strong—such was the advantage of their terrain.

units.zh: 五代之際，朝興夕替，制度禮樂，蕩為灰燼，唐節度使有鼓吹，故夏國聲樂清厲頓挫，猶有鼓吹之遺音焉。
units.en: In the Five Dynasties era regimes rose and fell overnight; institutions, rites, and music were reduced to ashes. Tang military commissioners had wind and percussion ensembles, so Xia music was clear, sharp, and abrupt, yet still bore traces of those ensemble traditions.
units.literal: In the age of the Five Dynasties regimes rose in the morning and fell by evening; institutions, rites, and music were swept to ashes. Tang military commissioners had wind and percussion ensembles, so Xia state's music was clear, sharp, and abruptly broken, yet still bore traces of those ensemble sounds.

units.zh: 然能崇尚儒術，尊孔子以帝號，其文章辭命有可觀者。
units.en: Yet they honored Confucian learning and revered Confucius with an imperial title; their documents and edicts contain passages worth reading.
units.literal: Yet they could honor Confucian learning, revering Confucius with an imperial title; their documents and edicts had passages worth noting.

units.zh: 立國二百餘年，抗衡遼、金、宋三國，偭鄉無常，視三國之勢強弱以為異同焉。
units.en: For more than two hundred years they contended with Liao, Jin, and Song, shifting allegiance without fixed loyalty, adjusting their stance according to which of the three powers was ascendant.
units.literal: Established as a state for more than two hundred years, they contended with Liao, Jin, and Song, shifting allegiance without fixed rule, adjusting their stance according to which of the three states was strong or weak.

units.zh: 故近代學者記西北地理，往往皆臆度言之。
units.en: Thus scholars of recent times who recorded northwestern geography often spoke from mere conjecture.
units.literal: Therefore scholars of recent times who recorded the geography of the northwest often spoke from mere conjecture.

units.zh: 聖神有作，天下會於一，驛道往來視為東西州矣。
units.en: When the sage sovereign arose, all under Heaven was united; post roads ran east and west and the region was treated as provinces of a single realm.
units.literal: When the sage and divine arose, all under Heaven was united as one; post roads ran back and forth and the region was regarded as eastern and western provinces alike.

units.zh: 遼主走陰山，耿守忠救西京，帝與宗翰等擊走之。
units.en: The Liao ruler fled to Yinshan; Geng Shouzhong came to relieve the Western Capital; the emperor with Zonghan and others struck and drove him off.
units.literal: The Liao ruler fled to Yinshan; Geng Shouzhong came to relieve the Western Capital; the emperor with Zonghan and others struck and drove him off.

units.zh: 而宗翰來會於濮，既平河北，遂取東平及徐州，盡得宋人江淮運致金幣在徐州官庫者，分給諸軍，而劉豫遂以濟南降。
units.en: Zonghan met him at Pu; Hebei secured, they took Dongping and Xuzhou, emptied the Song treasury of Huai–Yang gold stored at Xuzhou, shared the spoils among the hosts, and Liu Yu surrendered Jinan.
units.literal: Zonghan then joined him at Pu; once Hebei was pacified they took Dongping and Xuzhou, seized all the Song gold and coin the Huai–Yang transport had stored in Xuzhou's government vaults, divided it among the armies, and Liu Yu thereupon surrendered Jinan.

units.zh: 宋主乃貶去帝號，再以書來請存社稷，語在《宗翰傳》中，既而宗弼追宋主，宋渡江，入於杭州，複遁入海，宗弼乃還。
units.en: The Song ruler stripped his imperial title and wrote again to beg the realm be spared—the story is in Zonghan's biography; then Zongbi chased him, Song crossed the Yangtze into Hangzhou, fled to sea, and Zongbi withdrew.
units.literal: The Song ruler then cast off his imperial title and wrote again begging that the state be preserved—the account is in the biography of Zonghan; afterward Zongbi pursued the Song ruler, Song crossed the river, entered Hangzhou, then fled again to sea, and Zongbi returned.

units.zh: 於是，婁室所下陝西城邑輒叛，宗翰等曰：「前討宋，故分西師合於東軍，而陝西五路兵力雄勁，當並力攻取。
units.en: Then the Shaanxi cities Lou Shi had taken rose again, and Zonghan said, "When we first struck Song we merged the western host with the eastern army, but the five Shaanxi circuits are strong—we should strike with united force.
units.literal: Thereupon the Shaanxi towns Lou Shi had taken kept rebelling, and Zonghan and the others said: "In the earlier campaign against Song we joined the western army to the eastern host, yet the five Shaanxi circuits field fierce strength—we ought to attack together.

units.zh: 於是班師，與宗翰俱朝京師，立熙宗為諳版勃極烈，帝為左副元帥。
units.en: They withdrew to court; with Zonghan they installed Hela as an-ban boji lie and made the emperor left deputy commander-in-chief.
units.literal: The army then withdrew; together with Zonghan he came to court, Hela was installed as an-ban boji lie, and the emperor became left deputy commander-in-chief.

units.zh: 今撻懶撫定江北，宗弼以精兵二萬先往洛陽。
units.en: Tadan has pacified the country north of the river; let Zongbi march twenty thousand picked men to Luoyang first.
units.literal: Now Tadan has settled the north of the river; let Zongbi take twenty thousand elite troops first to Luoyang.

units.zh: 以八月往陝西，或使宗弼遂將以行，或宗輔、宗幹、希尹中以一人往。」
units.en: In the eighth month march on Shaanxi—either Zongbi leads the whole way, or one of Zongfu, Zonggan, and Xiyin goes."
units.literal: In the eighth month go to Shaanxi—either have Zongbi lead the army through, or send one among Zongfu, Zonggan, and Xiyin."
